issues.what: camera direction, horizon, and sun angle jump across the cover: 1862-1870 plunges perpendicular into the center of a left-lit globe with no top horizon, while 1887-1895 emerges flying tangentially below a curved top horizon toward a top-center sun
issues.fix: arc and pitch the dive camera toward the limb with matching sun direction before entering the cloud cover so pre- and post-cover frames belong to one continuous move

issues.what: entering the cover (2113-2127) pushes forward and drives the curved horizon up off the top edge instead of pulling out, then cuts across the cover to a perpendicular pullback from a centered left-lit globe (2140-2147)
issues.fix: pull back continuously so the orbital horizon drops and curves into the planetary disk across the cover without switching lighting or view axis

issues.what: frame 1879 is already in full whiteout at peak brightness, so the sheet only shows exiting the dive cover and omits the consecutive frames entering the cover
issues.fix: center the cover contact sheet across the transition (around frames 1874-1885) so consecutive frames both before and after the cover are shown

issues.where: frames 2132-2136, lower-left and lower-right corners and left limb
issues.what: fast radial blur breaks coastlines, city lights, and the hurricane into 4-5 separate stepped ghost copies and discrete streak taps instead of a smooth blur
issues.fix: increase temporal and radial blur substeps with continuous sampling so fast motion blurs smoothly without discrete ghost edges

issues.where: upper right near Moon and limb, frames 1830-1870 (and sheet-05.png frame 2140)
issues.what: the Moon stays pinned near the same screen position while Earth doubles in apparent size during the dive, causing Earth's expanding green aurora limb to collide with and overlap the Moon at frame 1870 and again at 2140
issues.fix: project the Moon from its true 3D world position so perspective pushes it outward off-frame as the camera approaches Earth

issues.where: background starfield and Milky Way, frames 2147-2174 vs sheet-01.png/sheet-02.png
issues.what: the Milky Way jumps ~45 degrees from a top-left-to-bottom-right diagonal before the dive to a nearly vertical band behind Earth after the rise despite returning to the same globe framing
issues.fix: lock the starfield skybox in world coordinates across all segments so the background stars and Milky Way do not reorient across the stop

issues.where: cloud field, shadows, and ocean surface across frames 1920-2099
issues.what: clouds, cloud shadows, and ocean surface detail are frozen onto static geometry with no cloud drift or water flow, while Earth's globe rotation in sheet-05.png (2147-2174) also stalls relative to its rate in sheet-01.png
issues.fix: animate subtle cloud drift and ocean specular flow in the terrain view and advance planetary rotation at a consistent rate across the entire stop

issues.what: the green aurora is nearly absent on frame 1680 and ramps in abruptly over frames 1680-1721 before holding steady
issues.fix: start the aurora at steady-state intensity at the beginning of hold or evolve its curtains smoothly without an initial fade-in pop
